ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; visible surface is approximately 95-98% low-intensity black/dark-grey.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid black contiguous field across both lobes; secondary sparse distribution of small (5-15 pixel diameter) circular grey nodes scattered across the medial and lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees; bounding-box depth is significant, roughly 1/6th of total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude varies from 3 to 12 pixels; most aggressive peaks located on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal edges tapering into pointed, jagged lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (light grey on dark background) scattered across both lobes; primary cluster of ~10 nodes on the right lobe; secondary cluster of ~5 nodes on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live biological encrustations (barnacles) visible as high-intensity white/cream clusters localized on the extreme lateral tips and along portions of the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular 'chunk' missing or deeply notched on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from standard serration frequency.
